questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That I wanted to learn the language and know more about the culture. And that I could see my self live in that city.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I loved everything outside the hospital. The hospital department was also good and the doctors were kind, but I didn't learned so much.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very difficult. So long waiting time on each respons from Copenhagen University. Sorbonne was pretty fast at responding.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I called several times to "studieservice" in Copenhagen University to get help with my learning agreement, but they didn't know anything. And the email I got has so many weeks responding time, and there wasn't a number to call. Very frustruating.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Very difficult. I was lucky to get a room in the Cité Universitaire on my own, but there was no help.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: If you don't live in the cíte as i did, it can be hard to find friends. Specially as a med student, as you dont have classmates. My best advise is to sign up for different things to do in the danish church, running clubs, erasmus clubs etc.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: my host university was okay, it was Copenhagen University that was the problem and made it very difficult. Almost so difficult, that I was about to give up.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Only to sign a learning agreement, which they made for me. Very easy.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: A personal study-adviser. Very kind and helpfull.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I was on an internship, so no courses.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Begin in very very good time, as they are SO slow and not very helpfull.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: They were very kind, but the level seemed a little low.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: It was an internship, so there was no teaching, only clinical rotation.

questions.answer: Madklubber, sprogklubber.

questions.answer: Bare nyde at bo i byen.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt, men sproget var lidt svært.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Vær åben, smilende og venlig. De vil alle gerne snakke og lære dig at kende. Tag selv initiativ.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ingen.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Deres åbenhed.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Nyd det
Vær åben og sig ja til det hele
En oplevelse du vil have med dig altid

questions.answer: At lære et nyt sprog, en ny kultur, få nye venner.
